container_limits: docker run -m 8g --cpus 8 for every measurement; builds -m 16g --cpus 8, CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=8
build: cargo build --release --features full,test-utils (profile.release: lto = true; codegen-units of the open-triplestore package 7 instead of 1, to keep this build apart from other worktrees' in a shared target); Criterion: cargo bench --features full, same override
notes: The machine was shared with another session's work; every run took the machine lock, and no 9M-quad run was made. The 8-CPU limit makes the capture-off mixed phase slower than the 24-CPU figures of 2026-10-15 (5 200 against 8 550 quads/s): compare within this folder only.
